scope: 2021 final partial original; intact Q1-Q5 and Q7(a)-(c) solved

visual_review: All 3 original-container pages, 3 final reconstructed exam pages, and 10 final solution pages rendered with Poppler and visually inspected. Layout extraction was independently traced and checked against the native original contacts before integration.
checks: Original complete wording, complement polarity, 50 percent clock duty, external Schmitt C, series control devices, and point labels compared with native photos.

Standalone diagrams use editable TikZ with no raster includegraphics or external input dependency.
No clipped text, overfull/underfull boxes, overlapping captions, blank extra pages, or pending placeholders in final sources.
limits: Archive folder supplies year attribution; photographed original has no printed year.

Original Q7(d)-(f) is incomplete; conceptual supplement notes are conditional on an unverified secondary transcription.
